The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] '''Spelunker probe droid''', also known as the '''chameleon droid''', was a [[mining droid]] used by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] to explore inhospitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] for valuable [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Many Spelunker [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] were later redesigned into [[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]] for military service in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
Used for initial exploration of [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] resources, the two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall Spelunker [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] had four articulated pincer [[Limb/Legends|legs]] for traveling and a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] to further support the weight of its cylindrical body.<ref name="negd" /> The legs could also generate traction fields, allowing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to walk vertically and even upside down.<ref name="db" /> The droid featured [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and copper/gold plating.<ref name="negd" /> The [[mining droid]]s, which were able to survive in a wide range of climates, were dispatched to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] via [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] pods, where they would use their sophisticated [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] to locate potential [[Mining/Legends|mining]] spots. Once the droids found an economically viable site, they would begin preliminary blasting in preparation for larger mining teams.<ref name="db" /> Many Spelunker probe droids were later renamed "[[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]]" and converted into class four droids capable of military service.<ref name="negd" />

==History==
The Spelunker probe droid was designed and built by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], a major manufacturer of droids, heavy weapons, and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], the [[Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], a powerful [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] trade organization, bought thousands of them for exploration. Taking advantage of their durability, the Guild used the droids to locate valuable resources on a number of inhospitable planets.<ref name="db" /> However, towards the end of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Commerce Guild joined the newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], another guild in the Confederacy, took many Spelunker probe droids to be converted for battle.<ref name="negd" /> They were fitted with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="db" /> military grade [[Mine/Legends|mines]],<ref name="TCWCG" /> and a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] array for camouflage. They participated in several battles in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], most notably the [[Ambush on Ilum]]. All of these units, however, were deactivated after the execution of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] at the close of the Clone Wars.<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Chameleon droid first appeared in [[Chapter 14 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|''Clone Wars Chapter 14'']], but it was not until the ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' that their origins as the Spelunker were explained.<ref name="negd" /> In the [[Wikipedia:English language|English language]], a "spelunker" is a person who explores underground areas either professionally or for sport.<ref name="definition">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/spelunker|text=spelunker|work=[http://dictionary.reference.com Dictionary.com]|archivedate=20201203213535}}</ref>
